programme.desc: S01 E01 — My Franken-Kitchen A couple has recently moved into their family's multi-generational home, and they've decided to renovate; Mike and Denese are tasked with keeping some of the historical details intact while creating a major refresh with a functional, open floor plan.
programme.title: Fix My Frankenhouse

programme.desc: S02 E08 — The Walls Have Secrets Mike and Denise take on one of their most eclectic houses yet with a fridge in the living room, an unusable kitchen and a hidden walled-off fireplace; they're tasked to bring a traditional vibe.
programme.title: Fix My Frankenhouse

programme.desc: S01 E05 — The Exterior Exorcism For the first time, each designer tackles a space of their own as they transform Bihl Manor's neglected exterior; battling the spirits and the elements, they're aiming to give the grounds a glow-up worthy of the judges.
programme.title: A Very Haunted Renovation

programme.desc: S01 E06 — The Final Fright In the season finale, the final two designers stand with only the dining room and kitchen restorations between them and $50,000! Tempers flare and even the house seems to protest as the designers face a tough battle to claim victory.
programme.title: A Very Haunted Renovation

programme.desc: S17 E15 — Snowbirds in Florida An Ohio couple happily starting their retirement wins the lottery again, and this time it's a $5 million score! Now, they're calling on David to find a holiday house in Florida that's near the beach.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S16 E03 — Family Bonds Siblings inherited money from their late brother, and after finding one a home in Palm Springs, David's ready to help the other locate a place of his own; it's a desert oasis exploration as David hunts for a stunner in the Coachella Valley.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S16 E08 — The Gold Lady of Naples After already spending over $5 million on her dream lake house in Wisconsin, a woman now asks David to find a dream vacation home in Naples, Florida; she's bringing her sister along, as David looks for properties in golfing communities.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S16 E10 — Pensacola Peanuts Gold star do-gooders who have struggled financially scratch up a $5 million win, and they barely know what to do with it; David steps in to make sure they spend some money on themselves and help find their dream home in Pensacola, Florida.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S13 E06 — Carolina Beach Legacy House A couple decide to invest an inheritance in a beach house that can be a legacy home for the entire family; they want something that's quirky and need David's help to search for just the right place in Carolina Beach, N.C.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S13 E10 — Lake Cumberland Dreaming Thanks to a $5 million scratcher win, a couple is ready move from city life in Cincinnati to lake life in Lake Cumberland, Ky.; they're looking to move back where he spent his summers as a kid.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S17 E10 — Melbourne Beach Hub-Life Living most of the time on the road in their RV, a couple's using an inheritance to find a place near the beach in Melbourne, Fla.; they look for a hub where they can rest and store their gear.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S13 E11 — Texas Tranquility After an unexpected inheritance, a woman is finally able to buy a home near her daughter and grandchildren; She wants a house that's no more than ten minutes away from her family.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S01 E01 — The Caves Beneath and Buried in the Past A homeowner explores a massive, unexplored cavern system hidden below her closet in Virginia. And in Pennsylvania, a couple opens boarded-up fireplaces in their fixer-upper and discover old spaces that may hold treasure.
programme.title: My House Has a Secret

programme.title: Scariest House in America

programme.title: Scariest House in America
